entries.label: self:move(dir, speed)
entries.description: Moves this frame by at most `speed` px in the direction `dir` (a vec2). The direction is normalised: a diagonal does not move faster than an axis.

params.name: speed
params.description: Maximum speed this frame, in pixels

entries.label: self:move_to(target, speed)
entries.description: Moves this frame by at most `speed` px toward the position `target` (a vec2); stops exactly on it without overshooting. Call it again every frame until arrival. Ex: self:move_to(vec2(100, 20), 30)

params.name: speed
params.description: Maximum speed this frame, in pixels

entries.label: self:add_velocity(dv)
entries.description: Adds `dv` (a vec2) to the current velocity. To accumulate an acceleration or gravity frame after frame. Ex: self:add_velocity(vec2(0, 1))

entries.label: self:play_anim("name")
entries.description: Starts the named animation defined in the SpriteAsset. No effect if already active.

entries.label: self:squash(t, duration, amount)
entries.description: Flattens the sprite (wide and low) then returns to 100% in `duration` frames. `amount` = intensity in percentage points. Ex: ground impact → self:squash(t, 8, 30).

params.name: t
params.description: Current frame of the effect, advanced by the calling script

params.name: duration
params.description: Total duration of the effect, in frames

entries.label: self:stretch(t, duration, amount)
entries.description: Stretches the sprite (thin and tall) then returns to 100% in `duration` frames. `amount` = intensity in percentage points. Ex: start of a jump → self:stretch(t, 6, 25).

params.name: t
params.description: Current frame of the effect, advanced by the calling script

params.name: duration
params.description: Total duration of the effect, in frames

entries.label: self:bounce(t, duration, amount)
entries.description: Shifts the sprite upward then lets it fall back (self.sprite_offset.y), `amount` px of amplitude over `duration` frames.

params.name: t
params.description: Current frame of the effect, advanced by the calling script

params.name: duration
params.description: Total duration of the effect, in frames

entries.label: self:shake(t, duration, amount)
entries.description: Makes the sprite shake (random self.sprite_offset), `amount` px max, fading to zero over `duration` frames. Overwrites any self.sprite_offset already set.

params.name: t
params.description: Current frame of the effect, advanced by the calling script

params.name: duration
params.description: Total duration of the effect, in frames

entries.label: self:flash(t, duration, pal)
entries.description: Switches to palette bank `pal` (self.pal) while t < duration, then returns to bank 0. Ex: damage → self:flash(t, 4, WHITE_FLASH_BANK).

params.name: t
params.description: Current frame of the effect, advanced by the calling script

params.name: duration
params.description: Total duration of the effect, in frames

params.name: pal
params.description: Palette bank to display during the effect

entries.label: self:blink(t, duration, interval)
entries.description: Toggles self.visible on/off every `interval` frames while t < duration, then stays visible. Ex: invincibility → self:blink(t, 90, 4).

params.name: t
params.description: Current frame of the effect, advanced by the calling script

params.name: duration
params.description: Total duration of the effect, in frames

entries.label: self:pulse(t, duration, amount)
entries.description: Grows then returns to 100% (self.sprite_scale), `amount` percentage points of amplitude over `duration` frames. Ex: collectible object → self:pulse(t, 30, 15).

params.name: t
params.description: Current frame of the effect, advanced by the calling script

params.name: duration
params.description: Total duration of the effect, in frames

entries.label: self:pop(t, duration, amount)
entries.description: Appearance: grows from 0% up to 100+`amount`% then settles at 100%. Ex: power-up spawn → self:pop(t, 15, 20).

params.name: t
params.description: Current frame of the effect, advanced by the calling script

params.name: duration
params.description: Total duration of the effect, in frames

params.name: amount
params.description: Overshoot at the peak, in percentage points

entries.label: self:wobble(t, duration, amount)
entries.description: Oscillates in rotation around 0° (self.sprite_rotation), `amount` degrees max, amplitude fading to zero over `duration` frames.

params.name: t
params.description: Current frame of the effect, advanced by the calling script

params.name: duration
params.description: Total duration of the effect, in frames

entries.label: input:held("nom"[, frames])
entries.description: True if the chord is held this frame. With `frames`, stays true after that number of consecutive frames, from 1 to 255. For a sequence, use `get_sequence`.

params.name: frames
params.description: Optional: minimum hold duration, in frames

entries.label: input:pressed("nom")
entries.description: True only on the frame the chord has just been completed (rising edge). Never reads a sequence.

entries.label: input:released("nom")
entries.description: True on the frame the chord was complete on the previous frame and no longer is (variable-height jump: releasing early cuts the momentum). Never reads a sequence.

entries.label: input:buffered("nom", frames)
entries.description: True if the chord was pressed within the last `frames` frames and has not been consumed yet. When the function returns true, it consumes that press. Place it after your other conditions in an `and`.

params.name: frames
params.description: Buffer window, in frames. Use a plain number, from 1 to 255.

entries.label: input:get_sequence("nom")
entries.description: True on the frame the declared sequence (Project Settings → Input → Sequences) has just been completed: its LAST step has just been completed, the previous ones having been found earlier, in order, within the sequence's window. Namespace separate from chords: never a button, never held/pressed/released/buffered.

entries.label: input:get_axis("x"[, "y"])
entries.description: Position of axis `x`: -1, 0 or 1. With a 2nd argument, returns a vec2 of both axes. "horizontal" and "vertical" (the d-pad) always exist, even without a declared axis; a project `InputAxis` (Project Settings → Input → Axes) is used the same way.

params.name: y
params.description: Optional: second axis, to receive a vec2

entries.label: self:play_sfx()
entries.description: Plays the Sfx configured in this actor's SoundFX component (see the inspector).

entries.label: sfx:play("name")
entries.description: Plays a one-shot sound effect (defined in project/sfx/).

entries.label: sfx:stop()
entries.description: Cuts the effect returned by `sfx.play`. No effect if that sound has already finished.

entries.label: sfx:playing()
entries.description: True while this effect is sounding.

entries.label: sfx:set_volume(percent)
entries.description: Sets the volume of THIS effect, as a percentage (100 = the level set on the resource).

entries.label: sfx:set_pitch(percent)
entries.description: Sets the pitch of THIS effect, as a percentage of its original pitch: 200 = one octave above, 50 = one octave below. The value is absolute.

entries.label: sfx:set_panning(panning)
entries.description: Places this effect in the stereo field: −100 left, 0 centre, +100 right.

entries.label: music:play("name")
entries.description: Starts a music track in a loop.

entries.label: music:stop()
entries.description: Stops the current music.

entries.label: music:pause()
entries.description: Pauses the music where it is.

entries.label: music:resume()
entries.description: Resumes the paused music, at the same place.

entries.label: music:is_playing()
entries.description: True while a module is playing. False after `music:stop()`, true during a pause.

entries.label: music:set_volume(percent)
entries.description: Sets the music volume, as a percentage. It is the only level of the module layer: the hardware has a single scaler.

entries.label: music:fade_to("name", frames)
entries.description: Switches to another track with a cross fade: the volume drops to zero, the track changes, it comes back up. Works between any two songs, at the cost of an audible dip.

entries.label: music:cut_to("name")
entries.description: Switches to another track WITHOUT a dip, at the end of the current pattern, resuming at the same position. This is what chains two variants of the same song. Both tracks must have the same structure.

entries.label: music:jingle("name")
entries.description: Plays a module OVER the current music, without stopping it. It never loops, only one at a time, and it takes up to 4 of the 8 channels. It is the only way to make two musics sound together on this console.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the Music played as a jingle

entries.label: music:jingle_playing()
entries.description: True while a jingle is sounding.

entries.label: sound_box:set_state("name")
entries.description: Changes the state of the SoundBox. Animation actions then use the samples of this new state.

entries.label: sound_box:set_volume(percent)
entries.description: Sets the volume of ALL effects, as a percentage. A mixing setting: it multiplies the own volume of each effect, it does not replace it.

entries.label: jingle_box:set_state("name")
entries.description: Changes the state of the JingleBox: which module each jingle action now points to.

entries.label: jingle_box:set_volume(percent)
entries.description: Sets the volume of the jingle layer, as a percentage. Together with `music.set_volume`, it is half of the duck: the music fades out during the fanfare, then comes back up.

entries.label: music_box:trigger("name")
entries.description: Emits a trigger of the MusicBox. The box chooses the target state and its transition.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of a MusicBox edge trigger

entries.label: camera:follow(target, mx, my)
entries.description: Follows `target` (a vec2) with a dead zone. Typically called in on_late_update.

entries.label: actor:get("name")
entries.description: An actor of the active scene, by NAME (literal) or by dynamic 1-based INDEX (actor:get(i), from 1 to actor:count(), in scene order). Returns nil if absent or destroyed.

params.name: name
params.description: Exact name of the actor, or its 1-based index in the scene

entries.returns: actor — actor reference, or nil if absent/destroyed

entries.label: actor:count()
entries.description: Returns the number of actors placed in the active scene. Use it as a bound with `actor:get(i)`.

entries.label: actor:spawn("prefab", position)
entries.description: Instantiates a pool prefab at `position` (a vec2). Returns the created actor, or `nil` if the pool is full.

params.name: prefab
params.description: Exact name of the Prefab (as created in the editor)

entries.returns: number — slot index in g_actors[], or -1 if the pool is full

entries.label: sequence:start(name)
entries.description: Starts or restarts a sequence of this script. The sequence is an `on_sequence_<name>` function in which `wait` and `wait_until` mark the pauses.

params.name: name
params.description: The name that follows on_sequence_ in the handler name

entries.label: sequence:stop(name)
entries.description: Stops the sequence midway. It does not resume where it was: a sequence.start restarts it from its first line.

params.name: name
params.description: The name that follows on_sequence_ in the handler name

entries.label: sequence:running(name)
entries.description: True as long as the sequence has not reached its last line. Enough to chain two sequences, or to freeze a control during a cutscene.

params.name: name
params.description: The name that follows on_sequence_ in the handler name

entries.returns: bool — true if the sequence is running

entries.label: save:write(slot)
entries.description: Writes the global variables marked "persist" into a save slot.

params.name: slot
params.description: Slot number, from 0 (their number is set in the project)

entries.returns: number — 1 if the save took place, 0 if the slot does not exist

entries.label: save:load(slot)
entries.description: Reads a slot again and REPLACES ALL the persistent variables of the current game. A variable absent from the file takes its default value; if the slot is empty or unreadable, nothing is touched.
entries.returns: number — 1 if the read took place, 0 otherwise

entries.label: save:read(slot, "name")
entries.description: Returns the value of a persistent variable in a slot, without loading that game. Returns the default value if the slot is empty, unreadable or does not contain this variable.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of a global variable ticked "persist"

entries.returns: number — the value of the variable in this slot

entries.label: save:exists(slot)
entries.description: True if the slot holds a readable save. Enough to show "Continue" only when there is a game.
entries.returns: number — 1 if the slot holds a save, 0 otherwise

entries.label: save:erase(slot)
entries.description: Empties a slot: save.exists then answers false for it.
entries.returns: number — 1 if the slot exists, 0 otherwise

entries.label: math.abs(x)
entries.description: Integer absolute value.

entries.label: math.clamp(x, lo, hi)
entries.description: Clamps x between lo and hi inclusive.

entries.label: math.sign(x)
entries.description: Sign of x. Returns -1, 0, or 1. Handy for normalising a direction.

entries.label: math.min(a, b)
entries.description: Returns the smaller of the two integers.

entries.label: math.max(a, b)
entries.description: Returns the larger of the two integers.

entries.label: math.lerp(a, b, num, den)
entries.description: Linearly interpolates between a and b at the fraction num/den. Ex: math.lerp(0, 100, frame, 30) slides from 0 to 100 over 30 frames.

entries.label: math.ease(a, b, num, den, "kind")
entries.description: Like math.lerp, but bending the fraction before applying it. "in" starts slowly and accelerates, "out" starts fast and slows down, "in_out" combines both.

entries.label: array(taille)
entries.description: Declares an array of integers filled with zeros. With two sizes, creates a grid whose argument order follows that of the indices. Lua arrays are indexed from 1.

params.name: taille
params.description: Number of elements. Give one size, or two for a grid.

entries.label: scene:switch(name)
entries.description: Switches to another scene at the start of the next frame.

entries.label: lang:set(code)
entries.description: Changes the active language and reloads the current scene to apply it. Actors and scene state then restart from zero.

params.name: code
params.description: Code of a language declared in the project

entries.label: lang:get()
entries.description: Index of the active language. The value 0 is the source language and can be compared to `LANG_<CODE>`.

entries.label: text:draw(tx, ty, id)
entries.description: Displays a text from the project table on the scene's interface layer. `tx` and `ty` are expressed in 8-pixel tiles.

params.name: id
params.description: Key of the text in the project table

entries.label: text:length(id)
entries.description: Number of characters of a text. It is the bound of the typewriter: when n reaches it, the text is fully revealed.

entries.label: text:clear(tx, ty, w, h)
entries.description: Clears a rectangle of w×h tiles on the interface layer.

params.name: tx
params.description: Column of the top-left corner, in tiles

params.name: ty
params.description: Row of the top-left corner, in tiles

entries.label: text:set_font(f)
entries.description: Loads a font into video memory. Only one font is resident at a time: calling this function again replaces the previous one. The first font of the project is loaded automatically at the start of each scene.

entries.label: interface:get("name")
entries.description: Returns a reference to the named interface element, such as a text, a panel or an image.

params.name: name
params.description: Exact name of the element in the layout

entries.returns: ui_element — reference, or nil if absent

entries.label: ui_element:show()
entries.description: Shows the element and its children, except those that are individually hidden.

entries.label: ui_element:hide()
entries.description: Hides the element and its whole subtree.

entries.label: blend:set_layer(side, bg, on)
entries.description: Designates a background layer as a blending target. Use `side 0` for the top and `side 1` for the bottom, determined by the rendering priorities.

entries.label: blend:set_obj(side, on)
entries.description: Designates the sprites as the top or bottom target. A sprite with `self.obj_mode = 1` blends independently of this setting.

entries.label: blend:set_backdrop(side, on)
entries.description: Designates the scene's background colour as a target. It is very often the missing bottom: where no layer draws, only the background is behind.

entries.label: blend:set_alpha(eva, evb)
entries.description: Sets the mix of alpha mode in sixteenths, from 0 to 16. `eva` controls the top and `evb` the bottom. Going over a total of 16 brightens the image.

entries.label: blend:set_fade(evy)
entries.description: Intensity of modes 2 and 3, in sixteenths: 0 = nothing, 16 = full white or black. A fade in or out is this value incremented frame after frame. Combined with window.set_blend(), the fade only applies in the chosen regions.

entries.label: palette:set_bg(bank, p)
entries.description: Replaces the colours of the BACKGROUND bank `bank` (0-15).

entries.label: palette:set_obj(bank, p)
entries.description: Replaces the colours of the SPRITE bank `bank` (0-15).

entries.label: debug:log(...)
entries.description: Writes a line in the mGBA log, never on the game screen. This function is removed from the ROM outside a debug build.
